outline:
先修課程：半導體元件物理、高等IC製程
探討奈米矽元件之物理模型，及物理極限之深層探討。
schedule:
Week	Course Contents
01	Introduction
02	Electrons and Holes in Semiconductors
03	Motion and Recombination of Electrons and Holes
04	Device Fabrication Technology
05	PN and Metal-Semiconductor Junctions
06	PN and Metal-Semiconductor Junctions
07	MOS Capacitor
08	MOS Capacitor
09	Mid-term exam.
10	MOS Field-effect Transistors
11	MOS Field-effect Transistors
12	MOS Field-effect Transistors
13	MOSFET in ICs --- scaling, leakage, and other topics
14	MOSFET in ICs --- scaling, leakage, and other topics
15	MOSFET in ICs --- scaling, leakage, and other topics
16	Bipolar Junction Transistors
17	Bipolar Junction Transistors
18	Final exam
assessment:
Grading:
1.	Midterm Exam.: 20%
2.	Final Exam: 30%
3.	Homework and quiz: 50%
